questions.question: What field is Willows currently focused on?

analyses.content: 录音明确提到公司通过市场调研后，现在只专注于一种产品（specialize in this one product），即书架（bookcases），对应选项A。
你可能会听到“very large number of products”或“retail outlets”而误选B或C，但这些都是公司过去的经营状况（used to），不是现在的重点。

Willows used to produce a very large number of products, such as tables, chairs, and light fittings. However, through market research, they realized that most of their profit was made from the sale of bookcases. So they now specialize in this one product.

questions.question: How did the department start its contact with Willows?

analyses.content: 录音提到校长在报纸上看到了一篇经理写的文章（saw an article... in the newspaper），从而对公司产生兴趣并开始联系，对应选项B。
你可能听到教授（Professor）或学生（student）而误选A或C，但教授明确否认了是自己联系的（wasn't through me），而学生去兼职是在联系建立之后才安排的。

Does anyone know how our department began its contact with Willows? Did you contact the company, Professor? No, Tom, it wasn't through me. Our headmaster saw an article that the manager had written in the newspaper and became very interested in the company. He contacted Willows and arranged for a student to work there full time during the summer.

questions.question: How did the student feel about the software?

analyses.content: 录音中直接说明该软件的界面很差，而且非常难以预测（very difficult to predict），对应选项A。
你可能听到“quickly drawing”而把意思听反，误以为软件画图慢选B，或者听到“interface”就选C，但录音说的是界面很糟糕（bad interface），必须整体听完语义。

Does anyone know what the student thought of their time working at Willows? Yes, he's a friend of ours. He worked as a member of the design team, creating technical drawings of the furniture using a computer. There was a special software that he used, which he said had a bad interface and was very difficult to predict. However, it was very efficient and helpful for quickly drawing up furniture designs.

options.option: They went to the IT department.
options.optionContent: They went to the IT department.

questions.question: How did the students find out about the effects of the software on the company?

analyses.content: 录音明确说明他们被允许去查看公司账目（inspect the accounts），这直接帮助他们了解了软件对公司的影响，对应选项C。
你很容易听到IT部门（IT department）或经理（manager）而掉入干扰陷阱，但录音强调了访客“不允许”进入IT部门（not allowed），且经理也没时间见他们。

Unfortunately, visitors were not allowed to access the IT department, but it was great to chat with his colleagues. Did you meet his manager? His manager is a very busy man, so he didn't have time to meet with us. However, we were allowed to inspect the accounts, which really helped us to understand the effects of the software on the company.

questions.question: The reason why the students have a face-to-face interview alone is that

analyses.content: 教授解释说，如果大家一起面试会有太多的干扰（too much disturbance），因此单独面试是为了减少干扰，对应选项B。
你可能会听到“realistic”就匆忙选了C，但录音说的是单独面试“更”真实（more realistic），而C选项的意思是“没那么真实”（less realistic），看选项不仔细就容易选错。

Can we do it as a group? I'm afraid not, Bella. I want to give each of you my undivided attention, and there will be too much disturbance if I interview you all together. Plus, it will be more realistic if I interview you alone.

questions.question: How did the two students perform in the exam?

analyses.content: 教授明确表扬了两名学生，说两人的分数都在平均分以上（scored above the average），对应选项C。
你可能会听到“disappointed”或“improve significantly”而误选A或B，但录音说的是“没有”失望（not disappointed），且“显著提升”是对他们未来的期望，并非已经发生的表现。

Have you finished writing the feedback on our exam results, Professor? Yes, I have, Tom, and I must say that I was not disappointed. I am glad to say that your performance has dramatically increased since you began attending this after-school club, and you have both scored above the average. If you continue to work hard, your results should soon improve significantly.

questions.question: In which TWO ways will the new system affect the company?

analyses.content: 录音中提到为了提高生产线效率以增加销量，公司的解决办法是雇佣更多的员工（hire more staff），对应选项B。
你可能在听的过程中忽略了“除非更换机器，否则生产时间不会减少”的前提，导致误以为新系统能直接降低生产时间（选项D），要紧跟否定词后的真实解决方案。

Unfortunately, unless they also replace the machinery in their workshop, the new system won't reduce the production time. If they can't reduce their production time, they won't be able to increase sales. The answer is to hire more staff in order to increase the efficiency of the production line.

questions.question: In which TWO ways will the new system affect the company?

analyses.content: 录音中指出该系统能完成数百人的工作，因此会显著降低人工成本（significantly lower labor costs），对应选项E。
你可能会听到“profit”就想选A，但录音明确否定了它能帮助公司获得更多利润（don't think it would help them to gain more profit）。

Can anyone tell me what business decisions might benefit the company? A new system would definitely benefit Willows. Their system is very outdated. I don't think it would help them to gain more profit. However, the system is capable of doing the work of hundreds of people. This would, therefore, significantly lower labor costs.

questions.question: Which TWO effects will the new system have on new clients?

analyses.content: 录音最后指出，新系统最大的好处是员工可以当面为客户设计，让客户能更多地参与到设计中（get a lot more involved in the design），对应选项A。
你可能会听到“labor costs”而考虑E，但这里明确说明因为仍然需要员工指导客户，所以在人工成本上并没有节约（no savings can be made in labor costs）。

It's a shame that staff are still needed to guide clients through the online system, as it means that no savings can be made in labor costs. I think the major benefit of the new system is that it enables staff to design the furniture in front of the client, which allows them to get a lot more involved in the design.

questions.question: Which TWO effects will the new system have on new clients?

analyses.content: 录音提到新系统具有很强的互动性，允许客户轻松浏览家具目录，这将为他们节省大量时间（save them a lot of time），对应选项D（wasting less time）。
你很容易捕捉到原词“from home”或“more contacts”从而不加思索地误选B或C，但录音明确说了客户“不能”在家连接系统，也“没有机会”吸引更多联系人。

How will new clients be affected by the new system? Unfortunately, the new system does not allow clients to connect to the Willows system from home, so they are unable to access their work online. This also means that the system presents no opportunity to attract more contacts since clients are unable to view it from their homes. Yes, that's true. However, it could definitely benefit clients who visit the showroom. The system is very interactive and allows clients to easily browse the furniture catalog, which will save them a lot of time.
